messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates are in the local time zone for each province/territory; the federal holidays apply nationwide):

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Federal holiday – falls on a Sunday, so the observed day is Monday, January 2. |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Observed on the third Monday in February. |
| **March 20** | Friday | Good Friday | Federal holiday – observed on Friday. |
| **March 23** | Monday | Easter Monday (Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Observed on the Monday after Easter Sunday. |
| **April 7** | Monday | Victoria Day (British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan, Yukon) | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 1. |
| **May 22** | Monday | National Patriots’ Day (Quebec) | Observed on the third Monday in May. |
| **June 19** | Monday | Canada Day (observed) | Canada Day falls on a Saturday, so the observed day is Monday, June 19. |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | Falls on a Saturday; observed on Monday, July 3. |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan, Yukon) | Observed on the first Monday in August. |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | Observed on the first Monday in September. |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving (British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan, Yukon) | Observed on the second Monday in October. |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day (observed) | Falls on a Sunday, so the observed day is Monday, November 8. |
| **November 11** | Thursday | Remembrance Day | Falls on a Thursday; no extra day off. |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Falls on a Monday; no extra day off. |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | Falls on a Tuesday; no extra day off. |

**Long‑weekend highlights**

- **New Year’s**: Jan 1–3 (Mon‑Wed)  
- **Family Day**: Feb 20–22 (Mon‑Wed)  
- **Good Friday/Easter Monday**: Mar 20–23 (Fri‑Mon)  
- **Victoria Day**: Apr 7–9 (Mon‑Wed)  
- **National Patriots’ Day**: May 22–24 (Mon‑Wed)  
- **Canada Day**: Jun 19–21 (Mon‑Wed)  
- **Civic Holiday**: Aug 7–9 (Mon‑Wed)  
- **Labour Day**: Sep 18–20 (Mon‑Wed)  
- **Thanksgiving**: Oct 9–11 (Mon‑Wed)  
- **Remembrance Day**: Nov 7–9 (Mon‑Wed)  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or formatted differently!
